lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: دَسَّىٰهَا is in the derivative form: دَسَّى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/س/ي   d–s–y to corrupt, to soil, to let down, to tempt. Of this root, دَسَّى dassā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَسَّى dassā [v. II, trans.] to corrupt, to tarnish ‏

(91:7–10) قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا the one who purifies it [his soul] succeeds and the one who corrupts it fails.
